title: Revoking or suspending a permit
rule: Only the Director may revoke or suspend, only on listed grounds, and only after a show-cause notice.
points: Grounds: a natural disaster needing regeneration; too many permits; a permit passed to someone who would have been refused; a permit granted against the Director's advice; the activity not carried out for a continuous year; s. 48 circumstances; a Minister's direction to meet an international convention.
The holder has 40 days to show cause.
The Director decides within 60 days of the responses.
The notice takes effect at least 14 days after issue.
Compensation is payable for some grounds.
The holder can appeal to the High Court.
